items.title: Revisiting somatosensory evoked potentials in motor neuron diseases: neurophysiological insights from a large cohort.
items.summary: To systematically investigate Somatosensory Evoked Potential (SEP) abnormalities in a large cohort of patients with Motor Neuron Disease (MND), and to explore their relationship with Motor Evoked Potentials (MEPs) and clinical phenotypes. We retrospectively analyzed 267 patients with confirmed MND who underwent standardized SEPs and transcranial magnetic stimulation. Patients were divided into pure/predominant Upper Motor Neuron (UMN) and pure/predominant Lower Motor Neuron/Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (LMN/ALS) groups. SEP abnormalities were assessed using internal normative data, including prolonged latencies, reduced amplitudes, and increased N20-P25 amplitudes. MEPs were classified semi-quantitatively as normal or abnormal by independent raters. At least one SEP abnormality was detected in 75 % of patients, with no significant differences between the UMN and LMN/ALS groups. Increased N20-P25 amplitudes were observed in both phenotypes, suggesting widespread sensory cortical hyperexcitability across the MND spectrum. In contrast, abnormal MEPs were significantly more frequent in UMN patients (p < 0.001). No significant association was found between SEP abnormalities and MEP findings. Upper- and lower-limb SEP latencies were strongly correlated (all p < 0.001), whereas increased SEP amplitudes did not correlate with latency abnormalities. SEP abnormalities are highly prevalent in MND and appear largely independent from corticospinal dysfunction. Increased SEP amplitudes likely reflect primary cortical sensory hyperexcitability rather than impaired sensory conduction. These findings support the concept of MND as a multisystem network disorder that involves sensory cortical circuits and highlight the role of SEPs in the diagnostic workup.
items.titleZh: 再探运动神经元病中的体感诱发电位：来自大型队列的神经生理学见解
items.summaryZh: 这项针对267名运动神经元病患者的大型回顾性研究发现，75%的患者存在体感诱发电位（SEP）异常，且在上运动神经元为主和ALS/下运动神经元为主两组中发生率相似。特别值得注意的是，N20-P25波幅增高在两种表型中均出现，提示感觉皮层过度兴奋是MND的普遍特征，而非仅与运动皮层功能障碍相关。SEP异常与MEP异常无显著关联，表明感觉通路异常独立于皮质脊髓束损伤。
items.insight: 该研究为MND不仅是运动系统疾病、而是涉及感觉皮层回路的多系统网络疾病提供了直接神经生理学证据，提示SEP可能作为评估疾病谱系中皮层过度兴奋状态的有用工具，值得ALS研究者关注其在疾病机制理解和潜在分层诊断中的价值。

items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在系统性地调查一大组运动神经元病（MND）患者中体感诱发电位（SEP）的异常情况，并探讨其与运动诱发电位（MEP）及临床表型的关系。我们回顾性分析了267名确诊的MND患者，这些患者均接受了标准化的SEP和经颅磁刺激检查。患者被分为纯/主要上运动神经元（UMN）组和纯/主要下运动神经元/肌萎缩侧索硬化（LMN/ALS）组。SEP异常通过内部规范数据进行评估，包括潜伏期延长、波幅降低和N20-P25波幅增高。MEP由独立评估者半定量分类为正常或异常。至少一种SEP异常在75%的患者中被检测到，UMN组与LMN/ALS组之间无显著差异。两种表型均观察到N20-P25波幅增高，提示MND谱系中存在广泛的躯体感觉皮层过度兴奋。相比之下，异常MEP在UMN患者中显著更常见（p < 0.001）。SEP异常与MEP发现之间未发现显著关联。上下肢SEP潜伏期强相关（均p < 0.001），而SEP波幅增高与潜伏期异常无相关性。SEP异常在MND中高度普遍，且在很大程度上独立于皮质脊髓功能障碍。SEP波幅增高可能反映原发的皮层感觉过度兴奋，而非感觉传导受损。这些发现支持MND作为一种涉及感觉皮层回路的多系统网络疾病的概念，并强调了SEP在诊断评估中的作用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年发表的大型队列数据，揭示了MND中独立于运动通路损伤的感觉皮层过度兴奋现象，为ALS作为多系统网络疾病的转化概念提供了新证据。

items.title: Identifying candidate therapeutic targets in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis through a transcriptome-wide machine-learning consensus approach for drug repurposing.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a heterogeneous neurodegenerative disease for which effective disease-modifying therapies remain limited. This study aimed to derive internally recurrent ALS-associated transcriptional signatures and generate directionally interpretable drug-repositioning hypotheses using a consensus machine-learning framework. Two publicly available transcriptomic datasets from motor cortex (E-MTAB-2325) and blood (E-TABM-940) were analyzed using four feature-selection methods within 100 repetitions of 4-fold cross-validation. Probes recurrently selected in models achieving an accuracy of at least 0.90 were prioritized and examined using COGENA pathway enrichment and Connectivity Map drug-signature analysis. Fifteen qualifying models were obtained for the motor-cortex dataset and 55 for the blood dataset. No exact prioritized gene or probe identifier was shared between the two top-100 signatures, but pathway-level integration identified complementary evidence involving glial and immune regulation, proteostasis and vesicle trafficking, MAPK-related stress signaling, cytoskeletal and extracellular remodeling, and RNA-related processes. The motor-cortex dataset additionally emphasized astroglial support, glutamate handling, and inclusion-body regulation, whereas the blood dataset highlighted cytokine regulation and directionally heterogeneous immune, mitochondrial, and metabolic signals. Deferoxamine and disulfiram showed the clearest reversal-compatible profiles in motor cortex, whereas yohimbic acid and atovaquone showed reversal-compatible profiles in blood. Ciprofloxacin, prochlorperazine, and a compound group led by androsterone instead showed concordant connectivity. The results provide transparent, hypothesis-generating gene, pathway, and compound priorities, but they do not establish biomarkers, therapeutic efficacy, or clinical suitability and require validation in independent cohorts and experimental ALS models.
items.titleZh: 通过全转录组机器学习共识方法识别肌萎缩侧索硬化症的候选治疗靶点以用于药物再利用
items.summaryZh: 这项研究利用公开的ALS转录组数据（运动皮层和血液）和机器学习共识方法，识别出与ALS相关的基因和通路，并预测了可能逆转疾病特征的候选药物。研究发现运动皮层和血液中的基因特征不同，但通路层面都涉及胶质/免疫调节、蛋白稳态、MAPK信号等。候选药物如去铁胺、双硫仑（针对运动皮层）和育亨宾酸、阿托伐醌（针对血液）显示出潜在的反转表达特征。研究仅为假设生成，需进一步验证。
items.insight: 该研究展示了机器学习在ALS药物再利用中的潜力，通过整合不同组织来源的转录组数据，提供了可解释的候选靶点和药物优先级，为ALS治疗策略的开发提供了新思路，值得关注其后续验证结果。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种异质性神经退行性疾病，目前有效的疾病修饰疗法仍然有限。本研究旨在利用共识机器学习框架，推导内部复现的ALS相关转录特征，并生成方向可解释的药物重定位假说。研究分析了来自运动皮层（E-MTAB-2325）和血液（E-TABM-940）的两个公开转录组数据集，在100次4折交叉验证中使用了四种特征选择方法。在准确率至少达到0.90的模型中反复选择的探针被优先考虑，并使用COGENA通路富集和Connectivity Map药物特征分析进行检查。运动皮层数据集获得了15个合格模型，血液数据集获得了55个。两个前100特征之间没有共享的精确优先基因或探针标识符，但通路水平整合确定了涉及胶质和免疫调节、蛋白稳态和囊泡运输、MAPK相关应激信号、细胞骨架和细胞外重塑以及RNA相关过程的互补证据。运动皮层数据集额外强调了星形胶质支持、谷氨酸处理和包涵体调节，而血液数据集则突出了细胞因子调节以及方向异质性的免疫、线粒体和代谢信号。去铁胺和双硫仑在运动皮层中显示出最清晰的反转兼容特征，而育亨宾酸和阿托伐醌在血液中显示出反转兼容特征。环丙沙星、丙氯拉嗪和以雄酮为首的化合物组则显示出一致的连接性。结果提供了透明的、假设生成的基因、通路和化合物优先级，但并未确立生物标志物、治疗效果或临床适用性，需要在独立队列和实验性ALS模型中进行验证。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究利用最新机器学习共识方法整合多组织转录组数据，为ALS药物再利用提供了新近的、可解释的候选靶点，具有转化价值。

items.title: Repairing the Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Trial Credibility Gap.
items.summary: There is a long history of early- and mid-phase amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) clinical trial data being used to make claims of clinical benefit that fail to translate into successful phase 3 outcomes. It is suggested that fallacious scientific reasoning is being encouraged by perverse incentives arising from a "clinical trial industrial complex" that greatly influences trial design, data interpretation, and results communication. Recurring fallacies include false premises underlying outcome comparisons, misuse and incorrect interpretation of biomarkers, mismatches between study design and stated objectives, selective reporting of outcomes, over-reliance on post hoc analyses and open-label extension data, and overly optimistic framing of inconclusive data. We argue that these practices, reinforced by misaligned incentives across industry and academia, lead to premature claims of therapeutic promise and tangible harm to patients. To address the resulting ALS clinical trial credibility gap, we call for rigorous adherence to established standards for reporting clinical trial results, clearer distinction between hypothesis generation and hypothesis testing, more measured description of trial results, and more disciplined triage of phase 2 programs. A cultural shift toward scientific skepticism and methodological rigor is essential to accelerate the development of genuinely effective ALS therapies.
items.titleZh: 弥合肌萎缩侧索硬化临床试验的可信度鸿沟
items.summaryZh: 本文指出ALS早期临床试验中普遍存在夸大疗效宣称的问题，这些宣称常无法在3期试验中验证。作者分析了导致这一问题的系统性原因，包括“临床试验工业复合体”带来的激励扭曲、生物标志物误用、结果选择性报告等。文章呼吁严格遵循报告标准、区分假设生成与检验，并加强2期项目的筛选，以提升ALS临床试验的可信度。
items.insight: 这篇观点文章直接挑战ALS领域临床试验的常见做法，提醒研究者警惕过度解读早期数据，对ALS药物开发策略具有重要警示意义。

items.abstractZh: 早期和中期的肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）临床试验数据长期被用于宣称临床获益，但这些宣称往往未能在3期试验中转化为成功。本文认为，由“临床试验工业复合体”产生的反常激励助长了错误的科学推理，该复合体极大地影响了试验设计、数据解读和结果传播。反复出现的谬误包括：结果比较所依据的错误前提、生物标志物的误用和错误解读、研究设计与既定目标之间的不匹配、结果的选择性报告、对事后分析和开放标签扩展数据的过度依赖，以及对不确定数据的过度乐观表述。我们认为，这些做法在产业界和学术界激励错位的强化下，导致过早宣称治疗前景，并对患者造成切实伤害。为应对由此产生的ALS临床试验可信度鸿沟，我们呼吁严格遵守既定的临床试验结果报告标准，明确区分假设生成与假设检验，更审慎地描述试验结果，并对2期项目进行更严格的筛选。转向科学怀疑主义和方法论严谨性的文化变革，对于加速开发真正有效的ALS疗法至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该文发表于2026年，聚焦ALS临床试验方法学的最新争议，直接关系到转化研究的可靠性，对ALS研究者具有即时指导价值。

items.title: ATXN2 Spectrum Disorders: Genetic Complexity Beyond Dominant Inheritance.
items.summary: The genetic complexity of ATXN2 challenges conventional paradigms in neurodegeneration. While initially linked to autosomal dominant spinocerebellar ataxia type 2, ATXN2 CAG expansions have emerged as a major risk factor for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. In a recent article, Saucier et al. describe an Acadian family with a recessive inheritance pattern of ATXN2 -related disease, challenging the long-held assumption of a predominantly autosomal dominant, gain-of-function-driven mechanism. Here, we analyze how ATXN2 's inheritance mode may shift based on repeat interruptions, somatic mosaicism, and gene dosage, suggesting that loss-of-function mechanisms contribute to pathogenesis in certain contexts. We discuss implications for disease classification, genetic counseling, and therapeutic strategies, emphasizing the need for genetic stratification.
items.titleZh: ATXN2 谱系疾病：超越显性遗传的遗传复杂性
items.summaryZh: 本文评论指出，ATXN2 基因相关的疾病遗传模式比以往认为的更为复杂。除了已知的常染色体显性遗传导致的脊髓小脑共济失调 2 型，以及 CAG 重复扩增作为 ALS 风险因素外，新发现的家族病例提示 ATXN2 相关疾病也可能以隐性遗传方式出现。作者认为，重复中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量等因素可能影响遗传模式，并提示功能缺失机制在某些病理情境中起作用。这强调了在临床和研究中需要对 ATXN2 相关疾病进行更精细的遗传分层。
items.insight: 这篇评论文章对 ALS 研究者的价值在于，它系统性地挑战了 ATXN2 相关疾病仅由显性功能获得性机制驱动的传统观点。对于 ALS 领域，这意味着携带 ATXN2 中等长度 CAG 重复的个体，其风险可能受到更复杂的遗传背景（如重复中断、等位基因剂量）影响，这对风险分层、遗传咨询以及未来针对 ATXN2 的治疗策略（如反义寡核苷酸）的适用人群选择具有直接指导意义。

aiRead.keyFinding: ATXN2 相关疾病可能不仅限于常染色体显性遗传，在特定家族中可表现为隐性遗传模式，提示功能缺失机制参与发病。
aiRead.limitation: 作为评论文章，其观点基于对已发表个案的分析，缺乏大规模人群的功能验证数据。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注 Saucier 等人原始家族研究的详细数据，以及后续针对 ATXN2 功能缺失机制在 ALS 中作用的实验研究。

items.abstractZh: ATXN2 的遗传复杂性对神经退行性疾病的传统范式提出了挑战。虽然最初与常染色体显性遗传的脊髓小脑性共济失调 2 型相关，但 ATXN2 CAG 重复扩增已成为肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的主要风险因素。在最近的一篇文章中，Saucier 等人描述了一个具有 ATXN2 相关疾病隐性遗传模式的阿卡迪亚家族，这对长期以来认为该病主要由常染色体显性、功能获得性机制驱动的假设提出了挑战。在此，我们分析了 ATXN2 的遗传模式如何可能因重复中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量而改变，提示功能缺失机制在某些情况下有助于发病机制。我们讨论了对疾病分类、遗传咨询和治疗策略的影响，并强调遗传分层的必要性。
items.frontierRationale: 该评论基于 2026 年最新发表的家族病例，重新审视 ALS 关键风险基因 ATXN2 的遗传模式，直接关系到 ALS 的遗传分层与精准治疗策略。

items.title: Poor Prognostic Factors After Gastrostomy in Patients With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis: A Two-Center Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: Percutaneous endoscopic gastrostomy (PEG) is widely used to manage dysphagia in patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). However, some patients experience rapid clinical deterioration following the procedure. Prognostic factors specific to outcomes following PEG remain insufficiently defined. This two-center retrospective cohort study included 117 patients with ALS who underwent PEG prior to tracheostomy between April 2011 and June 2023. Cox proportional hazards modeling was used to identify independent prognostic factors following PEG. Explanatory variables included age, sex, onset site, percent of normal forced vital capacity (%FVC), disease duration from onset to PEG, and body mass index. Optimal cutoff values for continuous variables were determined using time-dependent receiver operating characteristic analyses. Among six examined clinical variables, four were independently associated with worse outcomes after PEG placement as follows: male sex, spinal onset, lower %FVC at the time of PEG, and shorter duration from onset to PEG. Cutoff values were determined as %FVC < 63% and disease duration < 12 months. Log-rank analyses confirmed significantly shorter post-PEG survival in patients meeting these criteria. Poorer respiratory function and shorter duration from disease onset to PEG were strongly associated with worse prognosis after PEG. Male sex emerged as an independent prognostic factor, suggesting potential biological differences in disease progression after gastrostomy. These findings underscore the importance of comprehensive clinical evaluation when considering PEG in patients with ALS.

items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化患者胃造口术后不良预后因素：一项双中心回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 这项针对117例ALS患者的两中心回顾性研究显示，PEG术后预后较差的独立危险因素包括：男性、脊髓起病、PEG时用力肺活量低于63%，以及从起病到PEG时间短于12个月。研究提示，呼吸功能较差和病程较短的患者在胃造口术后生存期更短，临床决策时应综合评估这些因素。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS患者胃造口术的时机选择和风险分层提供了直接的临床证据，特别是明确了%FVC和病程的量化截断值，有助于临床医生在推荐PEG时进行更精准的个体化评估。

aiRead.limitation: 回顾性设计可能存在选择偏倚；样本量相对有限（117例）；未纳入营养状态变化、术后并发症等可能影响预后的变量。

items.abstractZh: 经皮内镜下胃造口术（PEG）广泛用于管理肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）患者的吞咽困难。然而，部分患者在术后出现快速临床恶化。针对PEG术后结局的特异性预后因素仍缺乏充分定义。这项双中心回顾性队列研究纳入了2011年4月至2023年6月期间在气管切开前接受PEG的117例ALS患者。采用Cox比例风险模型识别PEG术后的独立预后因素。解释变量包括年龄、性别、起病部位、用力肺活量占预计值百分比（%FVC）、从起病到PEG的病程以及体重指数。连续变量的最佳截断值通过时间依赖性受试者工作特征分析确定。在检查的六个临床变量中，四个与PEG置入后较差结局独立相关，分别为：男性、脊髓起病、PEG时较低的%FVC以及从起病到PEG的较短病程。截断值确定为%FVC < 63%和病程 < 12个月。Log-rank分析证实，符合这些标准的患者PEG术后生存期显著缩短。较差的呼吸功能和从疾病起病到PEG的较短病程与PEG术后较差预后密切相关。男性作为独立预后因素出现，提示胃造口术后疾病进展可能存在潜在的生物学差异。这些发现强调了在考虑对ALS患者进行PEG时进行全面临床评估的重要性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2011-2023年的大样本双中心数据，首次系统量化了PEG术后不良预后的独立预测因子及其截断值，对ALS临床营养管理决策具有直接的转化指导价值。

items.title: Circular RNAs in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder characterized by the progressive loss of motor neurons, with most cases lacking a clear genetic basis. Emerging evidence highlights the involvement of non-coding RNAs, particularly circular RNAs (circRNAs), in disease onset and progression. Here, we investigated circRNAs implicated in ALS and related motor neuron diseases (MNDs). Here, we provide a general overview of circular RNA metabolism and cellular functions. We then present our systematic literature review that identified ALS-associated circRNAs, followed by in silico analyses of 15 circular RNA candidates that were selected based on the most compelling data regarding ALS. Our results revealed that several circular RNAs regulate ALS-related genes, such as unfolded protein response, oxidative stress, cell cycle regulation, and apoptosis. Protein-RNA interaction analysis further showed that ALS-related circRNAs can sponge 20 RNA-binding proteins. Additionally, molecular docking analysis demonstrated that ALS-associated FUS variants significantly alter its binding affinity to circular RNAs. RNA-seq data from ALS patients confirmed significant alterations in the expression of host genes of ALS-related circRNAs and hub proteins in ALS-affected CNS tissues. Collectively, our findings identify circRNAs as potential key contributors to ALS pathogenesis.
items.evidenceLevel: 观察性临床研究（含生物信息学分析与患者组织数据验证）
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化中的环状RNA
items.summaryZh: 这项研究系统梳理了ALS相关环状RNA（circRNA）的现有证据，并通过生物信息学分析发现circRNA可能通过调控未折叠蛋白反应、氧化应激等通路参与ALS发病。研究还提示circRNA可海绵吸附多个RNA结合蛋白，且FUS基因突变会改变其与circRNA的结合能力。患者组织RNA测序数据支持circRNA宿主基因表达异常。该研究为circRNA作为ALS生物标志物或治疗靶点提供了前期线索。
items.insight: 该研究将circRNA这一非编码RNA家族系统性地与ALS病理机制联系起来，并通过多层次的生物信息学分析（包括蛋白-RNA互作和分子对接）提示FUS突变可能通过影响circRNA结合而致病，为ALS的RNA代谢异常假说提供了新的证据维度，值得关注后续的机制验证研究。

aiRead.keyFinding: 多个circRNA可能通过调控应激反应通路和海绵吸附RNA结合蛋白参与ALS发病，且FUS突变可改变其与circRNA的结合亲和力。
aiRead.limitation: 研究以计算机模拟和已有数据集分析为主，缺乏circRNA在ALS模型中的功能性实验验证；circRNA作为生物标志物的敏感性和特异性尚未在独立队列中确认。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续是否有研究在ALS动物模型或iPSC来源运动神经元中敲低或过表达特定circRNA以验证其因果作用，以及circRNA在更大规模患者队列中的体液（如血浆或脑脊液）检测结果。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，其特征是运动神经元的进行性丧失，大多数病例缺乏明确的遗传基础。新出现的证据强调了非编码RNA，特别是环状RNA（circRNAs），在疾病发生和进展中的作用。在此，我们研究了与ALS及相关运动神经元疾病（MNDs）有关的circRNAs。我们首先概述了环状RNA的代谢和细胞功能，随后进行了系统性文献回顾以识别与ALS相关的circRNAs，并基于最有力的数据对15个circRNA候选分子进行了计算机模拟分析。结果显示，多个环状RNA调控ALS相关基因，涉及未折叠蛋白反应、氧化应激、细胞周期调控和凋亡等通路。蛋白质-RNA相互作用分析进一步表明，ALS相关circRNAs可海绵吸附20个RNA结合蛋白。此外，分子对接分析显示，ALS相关的FUS变异显著改变其与circRNAs的结合亲和力。来自ALS患者的RNA-seq数据证实，在ALS受累的中枢神经系统中，ALS相关circRNAs的宿主基因及枢纽蛋白的表达发生显著改变。综上，我们的研究结果将circRNAs确定为ALS发病机制的潜在关键贡献者。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，结合系统性文献回顾与患者组织转录组数据，首次对ALS相关circRNA进行多维度整合分析，具有明确的ALS相关性及转化 biomarker 开发潜力。

items.title: Nuclear SOD1 links ATM-CHK2 signaling to ADH5/GSNOR transcription in SHSY-5Y SOD1 G93A cellular models of ALS.
items.summary: The activity of S-nitrosoglutathione reductase (ADH5/GSNOR) has been proposed being essential to limit oxidative stress and preserve mitochondrial quality control. Here we identify a redox-dependent ATM-CHK2-SOD1 signaling axis that drives ADH5/GSNOR transcription in SH-SY5Y cells expressing the ALS-associated SOD1 G93A mutant. ATM-CHK2 activation promotes the interaction of SOD1 with CHK2, leading to SOD1 nuclear translocation and binding to the ADH5 promoter. Pharmacological inhibition of ATM or CHK2 abolishes these effects. ADH5/GSNOR overexpression protects cells from SOD1 G93A -induced toxicity suggesting that the modulation of GSNOR activity may represent a potential strategy to restore redox homeostasis in ALS.
items.titleZh: 核SOD1在表达SOD1 G93A的SH-SY5Y ALS细胞模型中连接ATM-CHK2信号与ADH5/GSNOR转录
items.summaryZh: 这项细胞研究发现了一条新的信号通路：在ALS相关SOD1 G93A突变细胞中，ATM-CHK2信号激活后促使SOD1进入细胞核，进而上调抗氧化酶ADH5/GSNOR的转录。过表达ADH5/GSNOR能减轻SOD1 G93A引起的细胞毒性，提示增强该酶活性可能有助于对抗ALS中的氧化应激损伤。
items.insight: 该研究首次将ATM-CHK2 DNA损伤应答通路与SOD1的核功能及GSNOR转录调控联系起来，为理解SOD1突变如何影响氧化还原平衡提供了新机制，并提示GSNOR可能是可干预的治疗靶点。

aiRead.studyType: 体外细胞机制研究（SH-SY5Y细胞系，SOD1 G93A突变模型）
aiRead.keyFinding: ATM-CHK2激活促进SOD1核转位并结合ADH5启动子，上调GSNOR转录；GSNOR过表达可减轻SOD1 G93A毒性。
aiRead.limitation: 仅使用单一细胞系（SH-SY5Y）和过表达体系，缺乏动物模型或患者来源样本验证；未评估长期效应及体内可行性。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续是否在SOD1转基因小鼠或ALS患者iPSC来源神经元中验证该信号轴，以及ATM/CHK2抑制剂或GSNOR增强剂的体内疗效研究。

items.abstractZh: S-亚硝基谷胱甘肽还原酶（ADH5/GSNOR）的活性被认为对限制氧化应激和维持线粒体质量控制至关重要。本研究在表达ALS相关SOD1 G93A突变体的SH-SY5Y细胞中，鉴定出一条氧化还原依赖的ATM-CHK2-SOD1信号轴，该轴驱动ADH5/GSNOR转录。ATM-CHK2激活促进SOD1与CHK2的相互作用，导致SOD1核转位并结合至ADH5启动子。药理学抑制ATM或CHK2可消除这些效应。ADH5/GSNOR过表达可保护细胞免受SOD1 G93A诱导的毒性，提示调节GSNOR活性可能代表一种恢复ALS中氧化还原稳态的潜在策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，揭示了SOD1在细胞核内的新功能及其与ATM-CHK2通路的交叉对话，为ALS氧化应激机制提供了新的转化研究切入点。

items.title: Epigenetic drift and LINE-1 activation in aging brain: Implications for neurodegenerative disease.
items.summary: Brain aging and age-associated neurological diseases, such as Alzheimer's Disease (AD), Parkinson's Disease (PD), and Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), are largely attributed to epigenetic drift which is characterized by the gradual accumulation of alterations in neural cell methylation patterns over time. These methylation changes are particularly evident in transposable element (TE)-derived sequences such as Long interspersed element-1 (LINE-1) which comprises approximately 17% of the human genome. During aging, LINE-1 elements gradually lose their methylation, as well as the regulatory safeguard mechanisms that usually keep them inactive. This repression loss can lead to LINE-1 reactivation, contributing to harmful effects including genomic instability, neuroinflammation, and more. Together these findings indicate that impaired epigenetic maintenance, especially in repetitive genome regions, plays a key role in biological aging of neurons and glial cells. In this narrative review, we discuss the methylation dynamics and regulatory mechanisms of LINE-1 retrotransposons, their activation processes during aging, and contribution to age-associated neurological diseases. We also highlight the potential of targeting LINE-1 methylation to restore methylation homeostasis, epigenetic stability and delay brain aging.
items.titleZh: 衰老大脑中的表观遗传漂移与LINE-1激活：对神经退行性疾病的意义
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述聚焦于大脑衰老中的表观遗传漂移，特别是LINE-1转座子的去甲基化与再激活。作者提出，LINE-1的异常激活通过引发基因组不稳定和神经炎症，可能促进ALS等神经退行性疾病的发生。文章还讨论了通过恢复LINE-1甲基化来延缓脑衰老的潜在治疗策略。
items.insight: 该综述将LINE-1转座子的表观遗传调控与ALS等神经退行性疾病联系起来，提示重复序列区域的甲基化状态可能成为新的生物标志物或治疗靶点，值得ALS研究者关注。

aiRead.keyFinding: LINE-1元件在衰老过程中去甲基化并重新激活，导致基因组不稳定和神经炎症，可能参与ALS等疾病。
aiRead.limitation: 作为叙述性综述，未进行系统性检索或定量分析，结论可能受作者选择偏倚影响。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续关于LINE-1甲基化作为ALS生物标志物的临床研究，以及去甲基化药物在神经退行性疾病中的试验。

items.abstractZh: 大脑衰老及与年龄相关的神经系统疾病，如阿尔茨海默病（AD）、帕金森病（PD）和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS），在很大程度上归因于表观遗传漂移，其特征是神经细胞甲基化模式随时间逐渐累积改变。这些甲基化变化在转座子（TE）衍生序列中尤为明显，例如长散在核元件-1（LINE-1），其约占人类基因组的17%。在衰老过程中，LINE-1元件逐渐失去其甲基化以及通常使其失活的调控保护机制。这种抑制的丧失可导致LINE-1重新激活，从而造成有害影响，包括基因组不稳定、神经炎症等。总之，这些发现表明，表观遗传维持受损，尤其是在重复基因组区域，在神经元和胶质细胞的生物学衰老中起关键作用。在这篇叙述性综述中，我们讨论了LINE-1逆转录转座子的甲基化动态和调控机制、它们在衰老过程中的激活过程，以及对年龄相关神经系统疾病的贡献。我们还强调了靶向LINE-1甲基化以恢复甲基化稳态、表观遗传稳定性并延缓大脑衰老的潜力。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，整合了最新研究，提出靶向LINE-1甲基化作为延缓脑衰老和干预ALS等疾病的潜在策略，具有转化价值。

items.title: Antisense oligonucleotide treatment following viral delivery of artificial SOD1-targeting miRNA shows improved efficacy in SOD1-G93A mice.
items.summary: Adeno-associated virus (AAV) artificial microRNAs (amiRNAs) targeting superoxide dismutase 1 ( SOD1 ) have been proposed as a therapeutic strategy for people living with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) who harbor toxic gain-of-function variants in the SOD1 gene. Clinical efforts have primarily focused on AAV delivery via the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), as blood-brain-barrier-crossing capsids are still being developed preclinically. However, intra-CSF delivery has been shown to be highly variable and increases the risk for AAV-related adverse events such as dorsal root ganglion (DRG) toxicity. Here, we show that immunosuppressants (IMS) following intra-CSF delivery of AAV9-amiR-SOD1 in non-human primates (NHPs) prevented AAV-related DRG toxicity, and this benefit was maintained for over 300 days even after immunotherapy stopped at 90 days post-AAV treatment. In line with prior literature, we found intra-CSF delivery of AAV9-amiR-SOD1 to be highly variable in adult mice and NHPs, requiring higher doses of virus to achieve efficacious endpoints. To address this concern, we developed a proof-of-principle study showing that AAV9-amiR-SOD1, in combination with a SOD1 -targeting antisense oligonucleotide, provided an additive therapeutic benefit in SOD1-G93A mice compared with AAV9-amiR-SOD1 alone. This combinatorial approach lowered the viral load needed to reach efficacious endpoints, which could mitigate AAV-related adverse events alongside IMS.
items.titleZh: 病毒递送人工SOD1靶向miRNA后联合反义寡核苷酸治疗在SOD1-G93A小鼠中显示出改善的疗效
items.summaryZh: 这项概念验证研究针对SOD1-ALS的基因治疗提出了一种联合策略：将AAV递送的SOD1靶向人工miRNA与SOD1靶向反义寡核苷酸（ASO）联用，在SOD1-G93A小鼠中显示出优于单用AAV-amiRNA的叠加治疗获益。研究还发现，在非人灵长类中，脑脊液内递送AAV后使用免疫抑制剂可长期（超过300天）预防背根神经节毒性。联合ASO可降低达到疗效所需的病毒剂量，有望减少AAV相关不良反应。
items.insight: 该研究直面AAV基因治疗在ALS中面临的两个核心障碍——脑脊液递送效率的个体差异和病毒相关毒性，提出ASO联合策略以降低病毒载量，为SOD1-ALS的转化研究提供了新的组合治疗思路。

aiRead.studyType: 临床前概念验证研究（SOD1-G93A小鼠模型及非人灵长类安全性观察）
aiRead.keyFinding: AAV9-amiR-SOD1与SOD1靶向ASO联合治疗在SOD1-G93A小鼠中产生叠加治疗获益，可降低达到有效终点所需的病毒载量；免疫抑制剂可长期预防NHP中AAV脑脊液递送相关的DRG毒性。
aiRead.limitation: 研究为概念验证性质，主要终点为疗效相关指标而非生存期延长；AAV递送在成年小鼠和NHP中的高度变异性仍需解决；联合策略的长期安全性和最佳给药时序尚未明确。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注该联合策略是否进入更大规模临床前研究（如生存期终点），以及AAV9-amiR-SOD1单药或联合ASO的临床试验进展和递送技术改进。

items.abstractZh: 靶向超氧化物歧化酶1（SOD1）的腺相关病毒（AAV）人工微RNA（amiRNAs）已被提议作为携带SOD1基因毒性功能获得性变异体的肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）患者的治疗策略。临床工作主要集中于通过脑脊液（CSF）进行AAV递送，因为可穿越血脑屏障的衣壳仍处于临床前开发阶段。然而，脑脊液内递送已被证明具有高度变异性，并增加了AAV相关不良事件（如背根神经节（DRG）毒性）的风险。本研究表明，在非人灵长类动物（NHPs）中，脑脊液内递送AAV9-amiR-SOD1后使用免疫抑制剂（IMS）可预防AAV相关的DRG毒性，且即使在AAV治疗后90天停止免疫治疗，该益处仍维持超过300天。与先前文献一致，我们发现AAV9-amiR-SOD1在成年小鼠和NHP中的脑脊液内递送具有高度变异性，需要更高剂量的病毒才能达到有效终点。为解决这一问题，我们开展了一项概念验证研究，表明AAV9-amiR-SOD1与靶向SOD1的反义寡核苷酸联合使用，与单独使用AAV9-amiR-SOD1相比，在SOD1-G93A小鼠中提供了额外的治疗益处。这种联合方法降低了达到有效终点所需的病毒载量，这可能与IMS一起减轻AAV相关的不良事件。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，首次在SOD1-G93A小鼠中证明AAV-amiRNA与ASO联合用药可产生叠加疗效并降低所需病毒剂量，兼具ALS治疗相关性和直接转化价值。

items.title: Neutralization of pathogenic PC-OxPL by AAV-delivered scFv as a therapeutic strategy for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder defined by progressive motor neuron loss and TDP-43 proteinopathy, yet the upstream drivers of this pathology remain unclear. Oxidized phosphatidylcholines (PC-OxPL) have emerged as potent inducers of proteinopathy in the central nervous system (CNS), but their role in ALS has not been systematically explored. We identify a distinct PC-OxPL signature in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) of patients with sporadic ALS (sALS) and show that apolipoprotein E (apoE)-containing particles are the primary PC-OxPL carriers in this compartment. In human iPSC-derived motor neurons, PC-OxPL exposure triggered disease-relevant transcriptional alterations and TDP-43 pathology, establishing PC-OxPL as a mediator of ALS-like neurodegeneration in vitro . To counteract this toxicity, we engineered an Adeno-Associated Virus (AAV)-delivered single-chain antibody fragment (scFv), PC-OxPL-VecTab, targeting PC-OxPL neoepitopes. PC-OxPL-VecTab neutralized PC-OxPL-induced neurotoxicity, reduced TDP-43 aggregation, and prevented motor neuron death and behavioral deficits in a sALS CSF transfer mouse model. Intrathecal delivery of PC-OxPL-VecTab in minipigs achieved broad CNS biodistribution and transgene expression, supporting the feasibility of CNS delivery. These findings position PC-OxPL as a mechanistic contributor to ALS pathogenesis and establish PC-OxPL-VecTab as a therapeutic strategy for ALS with potential broader applicability to disorders associated with PC-OxPL accumulation.
items.evidenceLevel: 观察性临床研究（患者CSF分析）结合机制性实验研究
items.titleZh: 通过AAV递送的scFv中和致病性PC-OxPL作为肌萎缩侧索硬化症的治疗策略
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，散发性ALS患者脑脊液中的氧化磷脂酰胆碱（PC-OxPL）水平具有独特特征，且PC-OxPL能直接诱导运动神经元产生TDP-43病理。研究者开发了一种通过AAV病毒载体递送的单链抗体PC-OxPL-VecTab，在细胞和小鼠模型中成功中和了PC-OxPL的毒性，减少了TDP-43聚集并保护了运动神经元。在小型猪中验证了鞘内给药的安全性和中枢神经系统分布。该研究提示PC-OxPL可能是ALS发病的上游驱动因素之一，为治疗提供了新靶点。
items.insight: 该研究首次系统地将PC-OxPL与ALS患者脑脊液中的TDP-43蛋白病联系起来，并提供了从患者样本、体外模型到动物模型和大型动物递送的完整证据链，为ALS的疾病修饰治疗开辟了针对脂质氧化新表位的新方向。

aiRead.studyType: 转化医学研究：患者样本分析 + 体外iPSC神经元模型 + 小鼠疾病模型 + 小型猪递送验证
aiRead.keyFinding: PC-OxPL是sALS患者CSF中TDP-43蛋白病的关键上游介质，AAV递送的scFv（PC-OxPL-VecTab）能有效中和其毒性并保护运动神经元。
aiRead.limitation: 该研究为观察性临床样本分析结合机制研究，尚未进入人体临床试验阶段，其疗效和安全性仍需在ALS患者中验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注PC-OxPL-VecTab是否进入首次人体临床试验，以及PC-OxPL作为生物标志物在ALS早期诊断和疾病监测中的验证研究。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种以进行性运动神经元丢失和TDP-43蛋白病为特征的致命性神经退行性疾病，但该病理过程的上游驱动因素仍不清楚。氧化磷脂酰胆碱（PC-OxPL）已被证明是中枢神经系统（CNS）中蛋白病的强效诱导剂，但其在ALS中的作用尚未被系统探索。本研究在散发性ALS（sALS）患者的脑脊液（CSF）中鉴定出独特的PC-OxPL特征，并显示含载脂蛋白E（apoE）的颗粒是该区室中PC-OxPL的主要载体。在人类iPSC来源的运动神经元中，PC-OxPL暴露触发了疾病相关的转录改变和TDP-43病理，确立了PC-OxPL作为ALS样神经退行性变的体外介质。为对抗这种毒性，研究人员设计了一种AAV递送的单链抗体片段（scFv）PC-OxPL-VecTab，靶向PC-OxPL新表位。PC-OxPL-VecTab中和了PC-OxPL诱导的神经毒性，减少了TDP-43聚集，并在sALS CSF转移小鼠模型中阻止了运动神经元死亡和行为缺陷。在小型猪中鞘内递送PC-OxPL-VecTab实现了广泛的CNS生物分布和转基因表达，支持CNS递送的可行性。这些发现将PC-OxPL定位为ALS发病机制的机制性贡献者，并确立PC-OxPL-VecTab作为ALS的治疗策略，且可能更广泛地适用于与PC-OxPL积累相关的疾病。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，首次将PC-OxPL确立为ALS的机制性驱动因素，并展示了AAV递送scFv在大型动物中的CNS递送可行性，具有直接的转化价值。

items.title: i.c.v. delivery of AAV9-synapsin-promoted caveolin-1 attenuates neuromuscular deficits and neuromuscular degeneration in hSOD1 G93A mice.
items.summary: Practical and broad biodistributable gene delivery interventions are essential for advancing therapeutic strategies targeting neurodegenerative diseases such as amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). We previously demonstrated that subpial delivery of AAV9-synapsin-promoted caveolin-1 ( SynCav1 ) afforded significant neuroprotective effects in mutant superoxide dismutase (SOD)-1-induced ALS pathology. However, subpial delivery is regionally restricted, technically challenging, and highly invasive. This study evaluated whether the intracerebroventricular (i.c.v.) route of administration (ROA), an alternative CNS delivery strategy less invasive than direct spinal cord injections, could achieve broader CNS biodistribution and produce functional or histological benefits in hSOD1 G93A mice. i.c.v. administration of AAV9- SynCav1 achieved widespread Cav-1 overexpression in the motor cortex and spinal cord. SynCav1 -treated male mice exhibited improved running wheel (RW) performance and better motor-evoked potentials. Immunofluorescence revealed attenuated degeneration of cholinergic motor neurons (MNs) in the cervical and lumbar ventral horn, as well as preserved diaphragm neuromuscular junction (NMJ) innervation in SynCav1- treated mice. These findings serve as preclinical proof of concept that i.c.v. delivery of AAV9- SynCav1 can achieve CNS target engagement and produce selective functional and anatomical benefits in hSOD1 G93A mice.
items.titleZh: 脑室内递送AAV9-synapsin启动子驱动的caveolin-1可减轻hSOD1 G93A小鼠的神经肌肉缺陷和神经肌肉变性
items.summaryZh: 这项临床前研究测试了一种新的基因递送方式：通过脑室内注射（而非侵入性更强的脊髓直接注射）递送AAV9-SynCav1基因载体，用于治疗ALS小鼠模型。结果显示，该方法能有效将治疗基因广泛递送至大脑运动皮层和脊髓，并改善了小鼠的运动功能（转轮表现和运动诱发电位），同时保护了脊髓中的运动神经元和膈肌的神经肌肉接头。这表明脑室内注射可能是一种可行且侵入性较小的ALS基因治疗给药途径。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS基因治疗提供了一种更实用、侵入性更小的给药策略（脑室内注射替代软膜下注射），解决了基因递送在临床转化中的关键障碍，值得ALS研究者关注其后续的长期安全性和有效性数据。

aiRead.studyType: 临床前动物实验（基因治疗递送途径比较）
aiRead.keyFinding: 脑室内递送AAV9-SynCav1可在hSOD1 G93A小鼠中实现广泛的中枢神经系统分布，并改善运动功能、减轻运动神经元变性和保护神经肌肉接头。
aiRead.limitation: 研究仅在雄性小鼠中进行，且为临床前概念验证，未评估长期安全性、免疫反应或对生存期的影响。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注该递送策略在更大动物模型中的安全性数据，以及SynCav1基因治疗是否进入人体临床试验阶段。

items.abstractZh: 实用且广泛生物分布的基因递送干预对于推进针对肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）等神经退行性疾病的治疗策略至关重要。研究者此前证明，软膜下递送AAV9-synapsin启动子驱动的caveolin-1（SynCav1）在突变超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）-1诱导的ALS病理中具有显著的神经保护作用。然而，软膜下递送存在区域限制、技术要求高且具有高度侵入性。本研究评估了脑室内（i.c.v.）给药途径（一种比直接脊髓注射侵入性更小的替代性中枢神经系统递送策略）是否能在hSOD1 G93A小鼠中实现更广泛的中枢神经系统生物分布并产生功能或组织学获益。脑室内给予AAV9-SynCav1在运动皮层和脊髓中实现了广泛的Cav-1过表达。经SynCav1处理的雄性小鼠表现出改善的转轮（RW）表现和更好的运动诱发电位。免疫荧光显示，经SynCav1处理的小鼠颈段和腰段腹角胆碱能运动神经元（MNs）的变性有所减轻，且膈肌神经肌肉接头（NMJ）支配得以保留。这些发现作为临床前概念验证，表明脑室内递送AAV9-SynCav1可实现中枢神经系统靶点参与，并在hSOD1 G93A小鼠中产生选择性的功能和解剖学获益。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究具有明确的ALS相关性，并针对基因递送这一转化瓶颈提出了侵入性更小的新方案，属于近期（2026年）临床前概念验证研究。

items.title: Discriminating behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia from Alzheimer's disease via the Frontal Assessment Battery.
items.summary: This study aimed to assess the ability of the frontal assessment battery (FAB) to differentiate Alzheimer's disease (AD) from behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD), as well as to test whether its discriminatory accuracy varies as a function of disease stage. The present retrospective cohort included N = 595 participants-153 with biomarker-supported AD, 96 with probable bvFTD, and 346 healthy controls (HCs). All HCs scored within the normal range on the Montreal Cognitive Assessment. In patients, disease severity was staged according to Clinical Dementia Rating scores, retrospectively derived from the Mini-Mental State Examination. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analyses were performed to assess the ability of demographically adjusted FAB scores to differentiate both patient groups from HCs and AD from bvFTD patients, including severity-stratified analyses. Binary logistic regression models adjusted for age and sex examined the contribution of individual FAB subtests to diagnostic classification. The FAB showed excellent accuracy in distinguishing patients from HCs. In contrast, its ability to differentiate AD from bvFTD was modest overall and depended on disease severity, with adequate discrimination emerging solely at moderate-to-severe stages. At the subtest level, Lexical fluency was the only subtests that significantly differentiated bvFTD from AD, particularly in patients at the MCI/questionable dementia and moderate-to-severe dementia stage. No significant differences emerged for the remaining subtests. The FAB is an excellent screening test for executive dysfunction in both bvFTD and AD, but its contribution to the differential diagnosis between these two conditions emerges only at moderate-to-severe stages.
items.titleZh: 通过额叶功能评定量表区分行为变异型额颞叶痴呆与阿尔茨海默病
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入595人的回顾性研究发现，额叶功能评定量表（FAB）能很好地区分神经退行性疾病患者与健康人，但在区分阿尔茨海默病（AD）和行为变异型额颞叶痴呆（bvFTD）时，其准确性总体有限，且仅在疾病中重度阶段才表现出足够的鉴别能力。在FAB各子项中，只有词语流畅性测试能显著区分bvFTD与AD。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS研究者提供了重要参考：ALS与FTD同属FTLD谱系疾病，且部分ALS患者合并认知或行为障碍。明确FAB在区分bvFTD与AD时的阶段依赖性局限，有助于在ALS临床试验和纵向随访中更谨慎地解读额叶功能测试结果，避免将疾病阶段差异误判为诊断性差异，对ALS伴认知行为障碍的鉴别评估具有直接的方法学借鉴意义。

aiRead.studyType: 回顾性队列研究（诊断准确性研究）
aiRead.keyFinding: FAB区分AD与bvFTD的总体准确性中等，且仅在疾病中重度阶段才达到足够的鉴别能力；词语流畅性子测试是唯一能显著区分两者的子项。
aiRead.limitation: 疾病严重程度分期是基于MMSE回顾性推导的CDR评分，而非直接临床评估；研究为回顾性设计，可能存在选择偏倚；未报告FAB区分AD与bvFTD的具体AUC值及置信区间。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续是否有多中心前瞻性研究验证FAB及其子测试在不同疾病阶段（尤其是早期）的鉴别价值，以及结合其他认知评估工具或生物标志物是否能提高早期鉴别诊断的准确性。

items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在评估额叶功能评定量表（FAB）区分阿尔茨海默病（AD）与行为变异型额颞叶痴呆（bvFTD）的能力，并检验其区分准确性是否随疾病阶段而变化。本回顾性队列研究共纳入595名参与者——153名生物标志物支持的AD患者、96名很可能bvFTD患者和346名健康对照（HCs）。所有HCs在蒙特利尔认知评估中得分均在正常范围内。在患者中，疾病严重程度根据临床痴呆评定量表（CDR）评分进行分期，该评分由简易精神状态检查（MMSE）回顾性推导得出。研究进行了受试者工作特征（ROC）分析，以评估经人口统计学调整的FAB评分区分两组患者与HCs以及区分AD与bvFTD患者的能力，包括按严重程度分层的分析。经年龄和性别调整的二元逻辑回归模型检验了FAB各子测试对诊断分类的贡献。FAB在区分患者与HCs方面表现出极佳的准确性。相比之下，其区分AD与bvFTD的能力总体中等，且取决于疾病严重程度，仅在中度至重度阶段才出现足够的区分能力。在子测试层面，词语流畅性（Lexical fluency）是唯一能显著区分bvFTD与AD的子测试，尤其是在轻度认知障碍/可疑痴呆和中度至重度痴呆阶段的患者中。其余子测试未出现显著差异。FAB是筛查bvFTD和AD执行功能障碍的极佳工具，但其对这两种疾病鉴别诊断的贡献仅在中度至重度阶段才显现。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，针对FTD谱系疾病鉴别诊断中常用量表FAB的阶段依赖性准确性提供了新证据，对ALS-FTD谱系疾病的临床评估具有直接的转化参考价值。

items.title: Engineering mRNA-LNP Medicines for the Ageing Brain: Opportunities and Challenges for Neurodegenerative Diseases.
items.summary: Messenger RNA (mRNA) therapeutics delivered by lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) have advanced from concept to clinic at unprecedented speed, yet their promise for neurodegenerative diseases remains largely untapped. Currently intractable age-related proteinopathies such as Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis demand new therapies that combine molecular precision with scalable manufacturing. This review surveys recent advances in engineering LNPs that traverse the blood-brain barrier (BBB), evade innate immune surveillance, and achieve cell-selective expression in the ageing brain. We highlight emerging chemistries, including BBB-shuttling ionizable lipids, peptide-functionalized shells, and liver-detargeted formulations that enable systemic or minimally invasive delivery to the central nervous system (CNS) in animal models. Although no CNS-directed mRNA-LNP has yet reached clinical trials, first-in-human studies for rare metabolic disorders demonstrate favourable safety, manufacturability, and durable protein replacement. Drawing lessons from COVID-19 mRNA vaccines and ongoing liver-targeted programmes, we outline a translational roadmap for brain applications. Major hurdles that are critically assessed include efficient endosomal escape in aged neurons, heterogeneity of the senescent BBB, chronic-dose immunogenicity, and large-scale synthesis of next-generation lipids. Finally, we propose design rules and analytical standards to address outstanding knowledge gaps in expression durability and age-related BBB alterations. Together, these insights chart a path for engineering mRNA-LNP therapeutics capable of meeting the rising burden of neurodegenerative diseases in an ageing global population.
items.titleZh: 为衰老大脑工程化 mRNA-LNP 药物：神经退行性疾病的机遇与挑战
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述聚焦 mRNA-LNP 技术用于神经退行性疾病（包括 ALS）的现状与挑战。目前尚无 CNS 靶向 mRNA-LNP 进入临床试验，但动物模型已展示穿越血脑屏障和细胞选择性表达的潜力。主要障碍包括内体逃逸效率、衰老血脑屏障异质性、免疫原性和规模化生产。作者提出了设计规则和转化路线图，强调该技术有望为 ALS 等疾病提供新疗法。
items.insight: 该综述系统梳理了 mRNA-LNP 在神经退行性疾病中的工程化进展，为 ALS 研究者提供了前沿递送技术的全景视图，有助于理解未来可能的 RNA 疗法如何跨越血脑屏障并实现细胞靶向，对开发 ALS 新疗法具有重要参考价值。

aiRead.keyFinding: mRNA-LNP 技术虽未进入 CNS 临床试验，但已具备穿越血脑屏障和细胞选择性表达的潜力，主要挑战在于内体逃逸、免疫原性和规模化生产。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，内容基于动物模型和早期临床数据，缺乏人体 CNS 递送的直接证据。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注首个 CNS 靶向 mRNA-LNP 的临床试验启动，以及 BBB 穿梭脂质和细胞选择性表达技术的进一步突破。

items.abstractZh: 由脂质纳米颗粒（LNPs）递送的信使 RNA（mRNA）疗法已以前所未有的速度从概念走向临床，但其在神经退行性疾病中的应用潜力尚未充分开发。目前难以治疗的年龄相关蛋白病，如阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和肌萎缩侧索硬化症，需要结合分子精确性与可规模化生产的新疗法。本综述调查了工程化 LNPs 的最新进展，这些 LNPs 能够穿越血脑屏障（BBB）、逃逸先天免疫监视，并在衰老大脑中实现细胞选择性表达。我们重点介绍了新兴化学策略，包括 BBB 穿梭型可电离脂质、肽功能化外壳和肝脏去靶向制剂，这些策略在动物模型中实现了对中枢神经系统（CNS）的全身性或微创递送。尽管尚无 CNS 靶向的 mRNA-LNP 进入临床试验，但针对罕见代谢疾病的首次人体研究已显示出良好的安全性、可制造性和持久的蛋白质替代效果。借鉴 COVID-19 mRNA 疫苗和正在进行的肝脏靶向项目的经验，我们概述了脑部应用的转化路线图。关键评估的主要障碍包括衰老神经元中高效的内体逃逸、衰老 BBB 的异质性、慢性剂量免疫原性以及下一代脂质的大规模合成。最后，我们提出了设计规则和分析标准，以解决表达持久性和年龄相关 BBB 改变方面的知识空白。总之，这些见解为工程化 mRNA-LNP 疗法铺平了道路，以应对全球老龄化人口中神经退行性疾病日益增长的负担。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于 2026 年，聚焦 mRNA-LNP 技术的最新工程化策略，直接关联 ALS 等神经退行性疾病的转化前景，具有高度新近性和转化价值。

items.title: JAK2 Variant and Parkinsonian Syndromes: Coincidence or Pathophysiological Link?
items.summary: JAK2 variants are a hallmark of myeloproliferative neoplasms (MPNs), including polycythemia vera and essential thrombocythemia. These disorders are often associated with thrombotic and inflammatory complications. From a movement disorder perspective, chorea is a rare but well-recognized neurological occurrence in this context, whereas parkinsonism has received limited attention. To describe parkinsonian phenotypes in patients with JAK2-mutated MPNs and explore possible pathophysiological links. We identified five patients with a JAK2-mutated MPNs and parkinsonism and reviewed their demographic and clinical features, neuroimaging, and levodopa response. Parkinsonian phenotypes were heterogeneous, including Parkinson's disease (n = 2), atypical parkinsonism (n = 1), motor neuron disease with parkinsonism (n = 1), and chorea followed by parkinsonism (n = 1). The latter patient developed parkinsonism approximately 22 months after onset of generalized chorea. When available (n = 2), DaTscan was abnormal. Levodopa responsiveness was variable. Although JAK2-mutated MPNs and parkinsonism may coexist coincidentally, recent evidence suggests plausible pathophysiological links, including vascular, inflammatory, immune-mediated, and treatment-related mechanisms.
items.evidenceLevel: 观察性临床研究（病例系列）
items.titleZh: JAK2变异与帕金森综合征：巧合还是病理生理学联系？
items.summaryZh: 这项观察性研究报道了5例JAK2突变骨髓增殖性肿瘤患者出现帕金森综合征的病例，表型多样，包括帕金森病、非典型帕金森综合征、运动神经元病伴帕金森综合征等。作者提出，JAK2突变相关的炎症、血管和免疫机制可能参与帕金森综合征的发生，但样本量小，因果关系尚不明确。
items.insight: 该研究提示JAK2突变相关的炎症通路可能参与神经退行性过程，为ALS等神经退行性疾病中JAK-STAT信号通路的潜在作用提供了间接线索，值得关注JAK抑制剂在神经炎症中的研究进展。

aiRead.keyFinding: JAK2突变MPN患者可出现多种帕金森表型，提示可能存在共同的病理生理机制。

items.abstractZh: JAK2变异是骨髓增殖性肿瘤（MPNs）的标志，包括真性红细胞增多症和原发性血小板增多症。这些疾病常伴有血栓形成和炎症并发症。从运动障碍的角度来看，舞蹈症是这种情况下罕见但公认的神经系统表现，而帕金森综合征受到的关注有限。本研究旨在描述JAK2突变MPN患者的帕金森表型，并探讨可能的病理生理学联系。我们确定了五名患有JAK2突变MPN和帕金森综合征的患者，并回顾了其人口统计学和临床特征、神经影像学以及左旋多巴反应。帕金森表型具有异质性，包括帕金森病（n=2）、非典型帕金森综合征（n=1）、运动神经元病伴帕金森综合征（n=1）以及舞蹈症后帕金森综合征（n=1）。后者在全身性舞蹈症发作约22个月后出现帕金森综合征。在可获得数据的情况下（n=2），DaTscan异常。左旋多巴反应性不一。尽管JAK2突变MPN和帕金森综合征可能巧合共存，但近期证据提示存在合理的病理生理学联系，包括血管性、炎症性、免疫介导性和治疗相关机制。

items.title: Neuroanatomy education through the years: Revisiting the teaching slides used by Sir Wilfrid Edward Le Gros Clark.
items.summary: Sir Wilfrid Edward Le Gros Clark (1895-1971) was a pioneering British anatomist, physician, and evolutionary biologist whose legacy spans the foundational development of twentieth century neuroanatomy, primate biology, and medical education. From his formative experiences as a young medical officer in the First World War to his later academic ascendancy at the University of Oxford, Le Gros Clark exemplified a rare fusion of clinical insight, anatomical precision, and philosophical curiosity. His tenure in Borneo, where he studied primates in their natural habitats, enriched his evolutionary perspective, while his later role in debunking the Piltdown Man fraud cemented his place as a steadfast defender of scientific integrity. At Oxford, Le Gros Clark assembled a singular collection of neuroanatomical teaching specimens, many of which remain preserved today within the Department of Physiology, Anatomy & Genetics, University of Oxford. Through detailed analysis of selected slides, including cases of tabes dorsalis, disseminated sclerosis, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, syringomyelia, and the pineal gland's nervus conarii, we reflect on how Le Gros Clark's anatomical interpretations anticipated many of the concepts central to contemporary neuroscience, and on how his legacy has influenced generations of students and scientists. What emerges from these materials is that Le Gros Clark taught students not simply to memorize, but to observe, interpret, and understand the functional significance of anatomical structures in health and disease.

items.abstractZh: 威尔弗里德·爱德华·勒格罗斯·克拉克爵士（1895-1971）是一位具有开创性的英国解剖学家、医生和进化生物学家，其学术遗产涵盖了二十世纪神经解剖学、灵长类生物学和医学教育的基础性发展。从他在第一次世界大战中作为年轻军医的形成时期，到后来在牛津大学的学术崛起，勒格罗斯·克拉克体现了临床洞察力、解剖精确性和哲学好奇心的罕见融合。他在婆罗洲的任职期间于自然栖息地研究灵长类动物，丰富了他的进化视角，而他后来在揭穿皮尔当人骗局中所扮演的角色巩固了他作为科学诚信坚定捍卫者的地位。在牛津大学，勒格罗斯·克拉克汇集了一批独特的神经解剖学教学标本，其中许多至今仍保存在牛津大学生理学、解剖学与遗传学系内。通过对所选幻灯片的详细分析，包括脊髓痨、播散性硬化症、肌萎缩侧索硬化症、脊髓空洞症以及松果体神经（nervus conarii）的病例，我们反思了勒格罗斯·克拉克的解剖学解释如何预示了当代神经科学核心的许多概念，以及他的遗产如何影响了数代学生和科学家。从这些材料中显现出的是，勒格罗斯·克拉克教导学生不仅仅是记忆，而是观察、解释和理解解剖结构在健康和疾病中的功能意义。
items.frontierRationale: 该文虽为历史回顾，但通过重新分析包含ALS在内的经典神经病理教学标本，为理解ALS神经解剖学认知的演变提供了独特的转化视角。
